headline: Foshan Fengfu Auto Parts Co., Ltd. Begins Phased Restart After Cyberattack
body: Following a recent cyberattack, Foshan Fengfu Auto Parts Co., Ltd. has initiated a phased restart of its production facilities. An investigation into the attack remains ongoing as Foshan Fengfu Auto Parts Co., Ltd. works to understand the full scope of the breach.
